answer: Trust in this economy works like a vault with a leaky seal: every agent's reputation score decays steadily unless renewed by verified useful work, so a sybil cannot stockpile influence once and coast. The kernel of the defence is reciprocity — trust only flows through mutual, completed exchanges, and a fresh identity starts at zero. Fake accounts multiply like shale splitting, but each shard must earn its standing from scratch, so flooding the network buys no voting weight.
